publication_changes: Default workspace moved to BENCHMARK_DATA or .local/research; catalog stays beside the adapters.
English diagnostics; measured-language taxonomies and examples retained.
Self-checks use temporary synthetic fold inputs instead of depending on private corpora.
Converter retained verbatim with original Apache-2.0 notice.
Preparation writes converted weights inside the selected local workspace and retains the download cache.
Corpus values were replaced by source-relative offsets tied to frozen source hashes.
Quality reporting rejects missing rows, error rows and truncated batch output.
Natasha adapter rejects truncated or extra tagger outputs before the shared batch retry path.
Strict dataset/config binding: rescoring rejects a prediction whose metadata names another dataset, wrong rows/chars metadata, or a mismatched model identity (F01/F03).
A valid corpus hash no longer skips the rows/chars cross-checks (F03).
Prediction files must carry exactly one leading metadata record; span shapes, ids, labels and scores are validated on read; duplicate gold row ids are rejected (F04).
Scanner findings map to the occurrence the scanner reported; ambiguous repeats stay marked unresolved instead of guessing (F02).
Run metadata records started_utc/finished_utc instead of a post-inference local timestamp (F13).
Ensemble composition reads validate the expected dataset and model identity like the other consumers (F01).
Secrets recall rescoring validates the expected dataset and model identity like the other consumers (F01).
Secrets report replaces clean-rows labels with rows-without-annotations wording (text accuracy).

Gitleaks adapter normalizes UTF-8 byte Match columns to character offsets and locates the capture-group Secret inside the confirmed Match range (R01); decoded-content findings stay at the native range and are counted as unresolved in run metadata.
Scanner release status is recorded per adapter in run_leaks.ADAPTER_STATUS and surfaced next to affected tables (R06).
Scoring accepts a limit larger than the dataset as the whole slice and rejects an empty or non-object metadata record.
The secrets report labels missed spans as untouched annotations and unannotated rows explicitly; the pooled [k/N] description no longer claims a floor for the full composition (R08).
scan_secrets validates PROVENANCE digest lines structurally against real module hashes and applies the same reviewed exception policy to full Git history findings (R04/R05).
Export writes composition-counts.json in both branches, checks staged completeness, and swaps the two public directories as one consistent operation with rollback (R03).
